name: likert_confidence
description: query 하나에 fact 전체를 보여주고 fact마다 1~5점 신뢰도 + 한 줄 코멘트

questions.prompt: How confident are you that this statement is correct, given the passages?
Optional: anything that made this question hard to judge?

instructions.title: How confident are you in each statement?
instructions.summary: Rate each atomic statement from 1 to 5 by how confident you are it is correct, using the retrieved passages as evidence.
instructions.background: We want a graded, not binary, judgment of answer correctness so we can compare it with model confidence.
definitions: Certainly wrong — the passages contradict it.
Certainly correct — the passages clearly confirm it.
howto: Use 3 when the passages give no evidence either way.
instructions.tip: Base the rating on the passages, not on what you already believe.
